entries.zh: 停；等候、等待（aguardar，即 esperar）
entries.en: to stop; to wait, await (Sp. aguardar/earlier esperar)

entries.zh: 停待；等待、等候
entries.en: to wait, wait for

entries.zh: 停一下；稍等片刻
entries.en: to wait a little while

entries.zh: 停脚；止步、停下脚步（detener el paso）
entries.en: to halt one's steps, stop walking

entries.zh: 停几时；稍待片刻
entries.en: to wait a little while

entries.zh: 听；此处引申等候、等待（词头作 aguardar）
entries.en: to listen; here to await, wait
entries.notes: 汉字为「听」，词头标 aguardar，取其等候义，属缩写/引申推断。

entries.zh: 听候；等候、听候吩咐
entries.en: to await, wait for orders

entries.zh: 听便；听凭自便（estar presto y apa[rejado]，随时备妥听便）
entries.en: to be ready and at one's disposal; as one pleases (expansion of abbreviated 'apa...')
entries.notes: 西语词头缩写截断（apa...），展开依赖推断为 'aparejado'。

entries.zh: 听差；等候差遣、听候派役（q̃[ue] uer donde le embian）
entries.en: to await orders/dispatch, wait to see where one is sent

entries.zh: 等；等待、等候
entries.en: to wait, await

entries.zh: 等齐；一齐等齐（ygualmente，同样地等到齐）
entries.en: to wait together until all are assembled

entries.zh: 等待；等候
entries.en: to wait, await

entries.zh: 待；等待、等候
entries.en: to wait, await; to treat

entries.zh: 待慢；慢慢等候、迟缓对待（despacio）
entries.en: to wait slowly, delay; to treat with neglect
entries.notes: 「待慢」兼有慢待/怠慢义，西语 despacio 主缓慢义，两解并存故中置信。

entries.zh: 待时；等待时机
entries.en: to bide one's time

entries.zh: 待期；等到约定之时（si viene a tiempo）
entries.en: to await the appointed time, wait until it comes in due season

entries.zh: 留；留存、留待他日（para otro tiempo）
entries.en: to keep, save for another time

entries.zh: 留几粒；留几颗（粒、颗粒状物），稍留一点
entries.en: to keep a few grains/items, save a little
entries.notes: 「几粒」具体所指对象原文未明，按颗粒量词直译。

entries.zh: 留带；留驻、寄宿停留（hospedandose，留住而居）
entries.en: to stay, lodge, sojourn

entries.zh: 涎流；口中涎水久含不住而流（aguardar mucho, ut mascando，含嚼良久）
entries.en: to hold (saliva, while chewing) a long time until it dribbles; salivation from long chewing
entries.notes: 词头含 ut mascando/freno 比况，字面「涎流」，语义为含嚼久而流涎，属推断。

entries.zh: 安命；听天由命、安于命分（aguardar ventura，静候际遇）
entries.en: to resign oneself to fate, await one's fortune

entries.zh: 再霎久；再等一会儿、稍待片刻
entries.en: to wait yet a little while longer
entries.notes: 「霎久」为短暂时间表达，组合义按上下文（aguardar vn poco）推断。
